title: Prevention of Incisional Hernia After Renal Transplantation
official: Prevention of Incisional Hernia After Renal Transplantation Using ProGrip Mesh
summary: Randomized clinical trial to determine the efficacy of mesh reinforcement in laparotomy closure in renal transplantation as measured by reduction in the incidence of incisional hernia at 2 years post-transplantation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Candidate for first kidney transplant

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient receiving a second or successive renal transplant.
sponsor: Fundacion para la Investigacion Biomedica del Hospital Universitario Ramon y Cajal
